package.name: litegrip_moveit_config
package.description:
MoveIt configuration for the LiteGrip gripper: the top layer of the litegrip stack (sdk -> ros2_control -> moveit_config).
Contains the semantic description (SRDF), the planning and joint-limit configuration, the MoveIt controller mapping, and a demo launch that brings up the whole stack including ros2_control.
The gripper is driven through a GripperCommand action rather than a trajectory controller, which is what a gripper's "close until contact and stop" semantics actually want.
